title: Constitution (One Hundred and Thirtieth Amendment) Bill, 2025
summary: Would remove a Prime Minister, Chief Minister, or minister who is arrested and detained for thirty days on charges carrying death or life imprisonment. A joint parliamentary committee is still considering the bill and has proposed modifications, including reinstatement if the case ends.

title: Constitution (One Hundred and Thirty-first Amendment) Bill, 2026
summary: Delimitation package tied to implementing the women's reservation law: it would have raised the Lok Sabha's maximum strength to 850 and enabled immediate delimitation. Defeated in Lok Sabha on 17 April 2026 with 298 votes, short of the special majority; the companion delimitation bills were withdrawn.
